description: This file defines the CandidateSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams and encapsulates various filtering parameters for candidate searches within the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties such as candidate ID, vacancy ID, candidate name, date filters, status, and sorting options.

classes.name: CandidateSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) extending FilterParams, used for filtering candidate search results based on various criteria like candidate ID, vacancy ID, application date range, status, keywords, and more.
